description: A community or social post the Job Alerts workflow matched against a user's keywords.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: IAM record id of the user whose keywords matched

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Post title, or its first line when the source has no title

fields.name: Source
fields.description: Where the post came from: telegram | rss | webhook

fields.name: Url
fields.description: Link to the original post, when the source provides one

fields.name: Snippet
fields.description: First ~300 characters of the post text

fields.name: IsRead
fields.description: true once the owner has opened it in the Job Alerts page; false until then
